messages:
maria_acct_mgr: Heads up — NovaLabs is disputing their May private deployment invoice. Platform fee true-up appears larger than expected after renewal.
billing-bot: Invoice #NL-2026-05 generated 2026-05-02 07:45 UTC. platform_fee: $28,250. renewal_effective: 2026-05-01.
kevin_billing: Tagging FIN-4902. Maria, do we have their committed capacity and whether a true-up window ran on 5/01?
maria_acct_mgr: Committed capacity unchanged. Customer noticed a "true-up" adjustment and a full monthly charge in the same invoice. Procurement put payment on hold.
josh_eng: Pulling billing events for nl-vpc-9. Quick query shows two platform_fee events on 2026-05-01: bf-11001 $9,000 (prorate), bf-11002 $9,000 (monthly).
olga_finance: Finance can OK a provisional credit to keep renewal momentum. Approve up to $9,500. Use GL CU-CR-TEMP.
kevin_billing: I'll mark invoice disputed and create provisional credit CM-NL-2026-05-P. Provisional amount $9,000 unless engineering finds different.
josh_eng: Root cause: renewal task created prorate and did not suppress monthly rollup when renewal aligned to month boundary. Patch ready (PR #4782). Scheduling backfill to remove bf-11002.
maria_acct_mgr: Messaging to customer: "We've placed a provisional credit of $9,000 while we correct a billing overlap. Final confirmation within 48 hours." OK to send?
kevin_billing: Send it and include FIN-4902 reference.
josh_eng: Backfill completed; duplicate bf-11002 removed; delta = -$9,000. ENG-BILL-227 resolved.
kevin_billing: Issued credit memo CM-NL-2026-05-1 for $9,000 and attached to NL-2026-05; invoice status: adjusted.
olga_finance: Finance to post GL CU-CR-TEMP $9,000 once CM processes. Closing FIN-4902 after ledger confirmation.
maria_acct_mgr: Customer replied: "Thanks, procurement cleared the hold." All set from account side.
